atoms.b: I am writing to request a transfer.

instruction.text: Select an appropriate formal replacement for the underlined words.

atoms.a: I am writing <u>to ask for</u> a transfer.
atoms.b: I am writing to ((++request beg_for)) a transfer.

atoms.a: Taking photos on the premises is <u>not allowed</u>.
atoms.b: Taking photos on the premises is ((++prohibited not_on)).
